name: Research a lead before a call
summary: Builds a pre-call brief for each deal that closes soon: the deal, its contact and company from the CRM, plus the company's profile, news and hiring from Apollo. The brief is written once as an internal note on the deal, with discovery questions. A person approves any change to the deal's next step.

covered_by.trigger-booked: gap: deals closing in the window stand in for booked calls (no meeting route is built)
covered_by.research-company: prep (HubSpot company, filled from Apollo's organization profile)
covered_by.research-person: prep (HubSpot contact, with Apollo's title and headline)
covered_by.build-brief: prep (the brief text, from fixed fields)
covered_by.prep-questions: prep (questions from the signals found; the rep adds judgment)
covered_by.share-brief: prep (the note sits on the deal, so the team sees it)
covered_by.log-record: prep (note created, then linked to the deal)
covered_by.post-call-update: queue (next step waits for approval); call notes stay a person step

crons.name: prep
crons.summary: Hourly: brief each open deal that closes within the window, and write its brief once as an internal note on the deal.

crons.name: refresh
crons.summary: Daily (22:00 UTC, 8 or 9 am in eastern Australia): re-read Apollo news and hiring for open briefs. Stores only; the note is not rewritten.

crons.name: queue
crons.summary: Daily (22:30 UTC): queue each brief's next step for approval. The deal changes only when a person approves it.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads, plus one internal note on the deal. Apollo calls are read-only: no personal email or phone is revealed, and nothing is added to a sequence, list or task. The one live operation sets a deal's next step, which a person approves first.

hubspot.covers: open deals in the window, their contact and company, the brief note on the deal, the queued next step

apollo.covers: contact title and headline, company profile, news and open job postings

gaps: Trigger: no booked-call route is mapped for HubSpot or Apollo here. Deals that close within the window stand in for upcoming calls. Confirm with the owner which trigger the clients use.

Clay: the platform's mapped operations are saved-search and routine runs that find new prospects, not a brief for a booked call. No adapter is built. Clay's Account Research Agents are in open beta, so their output is not a stable field set to map.
Call prep and discovery questions: the questions are built from fixed fields (jobs, news). The rep's own call prep is not in this build.
Share brief: the brief sits on the HubSpot deal, which the team can see. No email or Slack share is built.
Lead scoring: no route is built. Neither HubSpot nor Apollo scoring is read here.
HubSpot pipelines: the closed-stage filter uses the standard names closedwon and closedlost. A custom pipeline needs its own list before the deal window is right.

HubSpot property names (dealname, dealstage, closedate, amount, hs_next_step, hs_note_body, hs_timestamp, jobtitle, numberofemployees) are read from HubSpot's standard property set, not from the spec. Confirm each on the live account.
Notes on a deal are not read: the note search is mapped but not used, so the brief does not show the call history yet.
Both adapters are docs-only and offline-tested. Neither is proven against a real account: a HubSpot and an Apollo sandbox are needed.
